entries.action: Refine R-TTA/P5: adapter must act on CORRECTIONS (refinements of backbone outputs), never couple backbone predictions across members/variates; add input-conditioned gating. Same logic applies to any future legion-level correction sharing.
entries.note: cross-variate TTA must interact in correction space, not prediction space: coupling backbone predictions mixes uncorrected errors across variates under delayed supervision. CoRe = shared-anchor correction refinement (parameter-efficient bottleneck) + input-conditioned spectral gating; -25.8% MSE avg over backbones, -10.6% over SOTA TTA. Code available.
entries.relevance: P5/R-TTA adapter constraint + legion-aggregation insight (share corrections, not predictions).
entries.title: Correction-space Cross-variate Interaction for Test-time Adaptation in Time Series Forecasting

entries.action: Adopt as P5 meta-control IF P1 ever passes: scale adaptation intensity by regime-novelty (KS/Wasserstein-1/feature-distance/variance-ratio ensemble), loss-driven early stopping (no fixed budgets), regime-memory reuse only at >=30% loss improvement. Note the evaluation substrate: compact GRU/iTransformer/PatchTST/DLinear — our scale class.
entries.note: meta-controller wraps any forecaster with train/predict/save/load (exactly our HiveMind surface) and any gradient TTA; regime-guided wins 69.6% of 224 seed-averaged experiments (14 datasets x 4 horizons x 3 seeds, 672 runs); -5.7% MSE vs TTA at 5.5% faster; RG-EWC -14.1% vs EWC.
entries.title: RG-TTA: Regime-Guided Meta-Control for Test-Time Adaptation in Streaming Time Series

entries.action: Apply the verify-then-apply rule to memory/sharing work: retrieve compatible neighbors, align, aggregate coherent evidence training-free, and gate application on predicted benefit. Strengthens the P3 sharing-off verdict logic (unverified broadcast = the failure mode RACE designs out).
entries.note: training-free neighbor-residual correction (retrieve compatible neighbors, scale-align residuals, aggregate coherent evidence) + lightweight domain Gate deciding WHEN to apply; Gate transfers across backbones; improves all 72 cross-backbone comparisons over frozen targets; largest gains on high-error queries.
entries.relevance: P3 memory/sharing design rule + R-TTA gating pattern.
entries.title: RACE: Residual-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Neighbor-Rich Time-Series Foundation Model Forecasting

entries.action: Extend P2 with a semantic-group arm: group the 10 indicators into semantic categories, compare grouped/regime-conditioned use vs flat use. Also adopt its hygiene checklist (sequence alignment, backtest leakage) for any future native feature work.
entries.note: 95 engineered features into 11 semantic groups; regime encoder + adaptive gate bias self-attention by group; financially-aware composite objective (error + direction + cost); explicitly fixes sequence-alignment/backtest inflation bugs.
entries.relevance: P2 semantic-group arm + native-run hygiene checklist.
entries.title: Adaptive Financial Transformer with Regime-Gated Attention for Stock Return Prediction

entries.action: Add a causal-selection arm to P2: PCMCI/causal-discovery-selected indicators vs correlation-selected vs all-10. Expectation from literature: causal subsets win on stability, especially in stressed regimes.
entries.note: first comprehensive causal-discovery vs non-causal feature-selection comparison for asset-return forecasting; causality-inspired models outperform baselines, particularly in tumultuous markets; trades invariance-to-shift against raw prediction error.
entries.title: Causality-Inspired Models for Financial Time Series Forecasting
